data.about: Four vertical loads between two supports on the walls. A grey trial funicular spanned from wall to wall locates the division point i on the load line — the split of the vertical reactions, the same for any trial. Every pole o chosen on the parallel to the closing line A–B through i yields a funicular polygon that passes exactly through both supports.
